content: We need to find template that when applied to the given molecule (Nc1c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c1Cl) reproduces the electrophilic bromination of an aromatic ring. The product should have a Br substituting a H on aromatic ring. The given molecule currently has many Cl and an NH (aniline). The reaction likely replaces a hydrogen with Br, giving a bromo-chloro-aniline. The precursor (retro) would be the same molecule but with a hydrogen instead of Br (i.e., the starting aromatic with H). So we need a template that does aromatic bromination. Search for templates with functional_groups_formed halide and maybe bonds_formed C-Br. The earlier search gave many templates but not necessarily bromination. We need to find a template where the product has Br attached to aromatic carbon and the reactant has H. The template ID is integer (not hash). The search result gave reaction_id and template_hash but not template_id. We need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). Possibly the database uses integer template IDs. The search result didn't include template_id. Maybe we need to get template by ID after finding appropriate template. The result includes reaction_id; maybe template_id equals reaction_id? Not sure. Could use get_template with template_hash? But need template_id integer. Let's inspect one of the results: reaction_id 51493 etc. Might be template_id? The field is reaction_id, not template_id. Could try get_template with template_hash? But function expects template_id. Maybe template_id is the integer reaction_id. Let's try get_template with template_id 51493.
